record.title: Choose the coherent guest entitlement fixture
record.intent: Evaluate the ART baseline and admit a bounded ordinary-install fixture or another useful offline continuation.
requirements: Separate actual stock behavior from synthetic DNA and private-store state; never claim the missing physical FRAM was acquired.
Prioritize an ordinary installer and persistence witness over unrelated startup recovery. Define before, after, process-restart and guest-reboot observations when the fixture is coherent.
Keep capability redirection separate. Plan, inspect, admit at expected revision, commit and push before successor execution. Preserve exact bench questions without physical contact.
acceptance: A bounded next offline task is admitted from the actual result or an exact blocker is recorded.
